pages.text: Pleroma is everything at once, and that includes every fluid of every mod installed. First, every mod's fluids are distilled together in the $(item)Essence Distillery$() into that mod's $(fluid)Essence$(): one fluid that stands for all of them.

Each distillation takes up to twelve of one mod's fluids (16,000 mB of each) and gives 1,000 mB of Essence. A mod with more fluids is distilled in parts, and the parts (4,000 mB of each) into the whole Essence. JEI lists every mod's distillations; new mods' fluids join in by themselves. Only fluids that fit in a bucket count, and a server can leave fluids or mods out (essenceBlacklist).

Then the Essences go on, in the same Distillery, into $(fluid)Anima Mundi$(), the soul of the world: water, lava, Basaltic Magma and Deep Brine (16,000 mB of each) and 4,000 mB of every mod's whole Essence, twelve at a time, in parts if there are more. Anima Mundi is one of the five fluids of Pleroma. Essences live in tanks and pipes only: a containment cell cannot remember whose Essence it held.
